ALASKA MEDICAID
                                        Prior Authorization Criteria

                                               Qutenza™
                                               (capsaicin)


FDA INDICATIONS AND USAGE1

QutenzaTM is a TRPV1 channel agonist indicated for the treatment of neuropathic pain associated with
postherpetic neuralgia (PHN) and neuropathic pain associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN)
of the feet.

APPROVAL CRITERIA1,2,3

     1. Patient is ≥ 18 years of age AND;
     2. Patient has a diagnosis of neuropathic pain associated with postherpetic neuralgia (PHN) OR pain
        associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy of the feet (DPN) AND;
     3. Patient has tried and failed for a minimum of four weeks at a recognized therapeutic dose or has a
        contraindication to ALL of the following:
            a. Gabapentin or pregabalin
            b. Any tricyclic antidepressant
            c. Topical diclofenac
            d. Lidocaine patch 5% AND;
     4. Product will only be applied by a health care professional.

DENIAL CRITERIA 1

     1. Failure to meet approval criteria

CAUTIONS1

     •    QutenzaTM is only to be applied by a licensed health care professional and not appropriate for self-
          administration.
     •    Unintended capsaicin exposure can cause severe irritation.
              o Do not use on or near eyes or mucous membranes.
     •    Transient increases in blood pressure may occur during and immediately following QutenzaTM
          treatment.
     •    Substantial burning and pain may result from application of QutenzaTM.
     •    Reductions in sensory function have been reported following administration of QutenzaTM.

DURATION OF APPROVAL1

     •    Initial Approval: 1 month
     •    Reauthorization Approval: up to 12 months

QUANTITY LIMIT1

     •    Up to 4 patches per application. Dose may be repeated up to once every 90 days
